name: Historic Villages of Korea: Hahoe and Yangdong
description: Hahoe and Yangdong are two clan villages in South Korea, the first near Andong and the second north-east of Gyeongju, both founded in the 14th-15th centuries. Tiled-roof mansions of aristocratic families sit beside thatched mud-walled cottages, with forested hills behind and a river and fields in front. Wander the lanes, pavilions and academies to see how Joseon-era Confucian life was shaped by landscape.
